$comment: THE LAYOUT, AS DATA (RULE CFG). Every screen edge the builder, the export, the Educo app, the UAT scripts and the tests use is read from here. Change a number here and nowhere else. Rungs: 'from' is the first CSS px of the rung (the cascade runs mobile-first); keep them in ascending order. 'measure' caps a contained column on that rung; 'words' is how the Page check names its screens. narrowestPhone is the low-cost phone a row must still fit (RULE AF). editor.dockFrom is the editor's own chrome line (panels dock from it), not a rung; labelsFrom / labelsWideFrom are where the top bar's buttons show their words (wide: under a finger, and the right-hand group); brandFrom is where the 'Box Builder' name shows; sheetWidth caps a bottom sheet. webApp.screens are the Educo web app's breakpoints (Tailwind's sm / md / lg… and xs). Tailwind reads all of these through tailwind.config.mjs, so a class says lg: or labels: and never a typed width. uat.edgeHeight is the window height the UAT uses for a rung's edge.
